Introduction
This document sets out the inspection steps every five years for CO2 fire extinguishers; these extinguishers are used for fire fighting in enclosed places by expelling oxygen.
The first draft was prepared and tested by Eng. Hosny Hassan Hussein, reviewed by Eng. Medhat Mohamed Taha Khater, and approved by Eng. Hamdy Abdel Mawla Meleigy, General Manager of El-Shabab Gas Power Station
Approved by Eng. Safety Precautions
Issue an approved work order from the competent authority; maintenance personnel must carry the occupational safety and health category card | 
Fence off the area to mark the work area and place warning signs | 
Follow the occupational safety and health procedures for personnel and equipment and wear personal protective equipment (safety helmet, safety shoes, overalls, gloves 00 etc.) |

Occupational safety and health equipment such as safety helmet, safety shoes, overalls, gloves 000 etc. |
